result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: the bottom navigation appears to be missing the Orders icon, causing the tab to look incomplete and inconsistent with the other navigation items.

issues.description: The bottom navigation tab labeled "Orders" has no visible icon, while the other tabs have icons above their labels. This makes the navigation bar look visually broken and may make the Orders destination less recognizable.
issues.suggestion: Add or restore the Orders icon above the label, matching the size, color, and alignment of the other bottom navigation icons.
